what: Hand-read turning point and mechanism of every chomp1 ladder game medicham32 lost without a forfeit (abra/regmc 1.39.0). The numbers (values, drops, calibration, detectors) are derived by postmortem.js into measured.json; the labels here are judgement, read from the saved log and the decision's table.
run: solver/out/rotom/chomp1-2026-09-29T23-13-11-521Z (arm A miltank-gen5, 5 s, depth 0, CHOMP v1 preview, release eaa5becc54eb, rotation ladder-rotation.json with the flat 32/32/2 spreads that 1.35.0 later replaced)
turning_point_rule: The decision whose resolution the game did not recover from, guided by the largest value drop and the highest value (measured.json turning_points). Where the two metrics disagree, the report says which was taken and why.

classes.VISIBLE_KO: Stayed in, or switched in, to a KO that one of the four searched opponent columns already contained.
classes.SPEED_CONTROL: The opponent set Trick Room or Tailwind and the search went on valuing the position as if it had not (includes a double Protect into Trick Room).
classes.SUCKER_PUNCH: Sucker Punch into Protect, a status move, Helping Hand, Rage Powder or a faster priority move; it failed and the user was KO'd or the turn was lost.
classes.OUTSPED: A mon the search expected to move first moved after an equal-priority attacker and was KO'd. Our set ran Speed SP 2 (the flat spread), the opponent's Speed SP is hidden even on open sheets, or both.
classes.SETUP: A boosting move (Nasty Plot, Clangorous Soul) went unpunished, often behind our double Protect, and the boosted attacker won.
classes.BEHIND_FROM_PREVIEW: The value never rose above 0.46 and the lead exchange was lost in the first two turns.
classes.UNSEEN_ACTION: The decisive opposing action was outside the four searched columns while an obvious attack was available.
classes.PERISH: The Perish Song count was not in the search's world, so it attacked with both actives at perish 1.

losses.note: +2 Kingambit Sucker Punches Sneasler (not a KO) and stays in front of Volcarona's Overheat, which a searched column held; the value then ROSE to 0.76 without Kingambit. Floette-Mega Calm Mind behind Rage Powder closed it.
Same position: Kingambit Sucker Punches a full Volcarona to 2%, takes a Flame Body burn and Overheat (in the searched column, cell 0.851).
All four columns were switches or Hyper Voice; Gyarados-Mega's Lash Out KO'd Indeedee (0.75 -> 0.19). Turn 1 Will-O-Wisp plus Thunder Wave on both leads was also outside the columns.
Switched Indeedee in beside Excadrill while every column held Garchomp's Earthquake; the next Earthquake KO'd both.

Switched Gengar into slot b while all four columns held Sceptile-Mega's Earth Power into slot b; Gengar KO'd on entry. The largest drop is the turn before (Grassy Glide into a switched-in Armor Tail).
Farigiraf's Trick Room was a searched column; valued 0.815. Under Trick Room and sun, Torkoal's Eruption KO'd both next turn while Gengar's second Protect failed.
Will's case: mega Gengar plus Hippowdon double Protect while Farigiraf set Trick Room. 0.825 -> 0.259.
Farigiraf set Trick Room turn 1 and the value rose to 0.63 under it; Nasty Plot, then Helping Hand Expanding Force KO'd both after a turn-4 double Protect.
Sneasler at 12/187 (Speed SP 2) was expected to Close Combat first; Timid Indeedee's Hyper Voice moved first and KO'd it. 0.868 -> 0.002.
Lead Gardevoir-Mega plus Basculegion into Charizard-Mega-Y plus Garchomp: both ours gone by turn 2; peak 0.457 (CHOMP preview had valued the bring 0.719).
Kingambit Sucker Punched Raichu while it used Helping Hand, on turn 3 AND turn 4 (both failed), and Zap Cannon went into Raichu's Lightning Rod; Kingambit fell to the helped Scald. Peak 0.947.
Sucker Punch failed on turn 5 (Extreme Speed moved first) and turn 6 (into Garchomp-Mega's Protect); Flare Blitz KO'd Kingambit, then Rillaboom (the largest drop, after turn 7).
Rillaboom stayed in to Arcanine's Extreme Speed, which two searched columns held; the next turn Sucker Punch went into Protect.
Peak 0.31. Turn 1 Draco Meteor into a Sylveon that switched in; Indeedee lost turn 2.
Trick Room turn 1, then a Tailwind (outside the columns) on turn 5; valued 0.853 under it. Tailwind Double-Edge KO'd Indeedee, a double Protect, then both KO'd on turn 8.
Peak 0.35. Pyroar-Mega's Heat Wave took Salamence and Kingambit on turn 2; Kingambit's Sucker Punch was stopped by a switched-in Psychic Terrain.
Whimsicott's Tailwind (outside the columns) plus Indeedee's Psychic Terrain on turn 3; valued 0.68, then 0.27, and Kommo-o swept.
Turn-1 double Protect (sampled at 0.67 of the mix) gave Delphox-Mega a free Nasty Plot; turn 2 a double switch put Archaludon into the +2 Heat Wave.
Delphox-Mega Nasty Plot on turn 3; on turn 4 the columns held no Heat Wave and the +2 Heat Wave took Basculegion; turn 6 it took both.
Sucker Punch into Protect on turn 2 and again on turn 5, when Volcarona's Heat Wave KO'd Kingambit. 0.872 -> 0.363.
Values 0.95 and 0.84 on turns 4-5; turn 6 Sucker Punch was drawn by Sinistcha's Rage Powder (a status move) and failed; the Quiver Dance Volcarona's Heat Wave KO'd Kingambit.
Our Choice Scarf Basculegion (Speed SP 2) moved after the opponent's Scarf Indeedee on turns 3 and 4; Expanding Force KO'd it before it attacked. 0.77 -> 0.43 -> 0.01.
Same pair: Scarf Indeedee's Expanding Force before our Scarf Basculegion on turn 2; Annihilape moved before Gardevoir-Mega and KO'd it on turn 4.

Gengar's Perish Song on turn 1. Salamence and Volcarona sat at perish 1 on turn 4; every row attacked (cells 0.78-0.96); both fainted at the end of the turn and the forced-switch value was 0.057. The world notes are empty; double_protect.js already says ROTOM's world lays no Perish.
Fake Out flinched our mega Salamence while Kommo-o used Clangorous Soul; turn 2 Sucker Punch into Kommo-o's Protect; the boosted Kommo-o won.

Gengar-Mega (Speed SP 2) expected to Shadow Ball first; Espeon's Expanding Force moved first and KO'd it (0.73 -> 0.05). Earlier: turn-5 double Protect into Lucario-Mega's Nasty Plot. Turn 8 the server refused a switch: Espeon had Skill Swapped our Shadow Tag, and the search did not know our Incineroar was trapped.

fix_map.VISIBLE_KO: PORYGON2 v2 (the leaf) and depth; the table already held the KO
fix_map.SPEED_CONTROL: PORYGON2 v2 plus depth (a horizon fault: the one-turn leaf does not charge for the Trick Room / Tailwind turns); the human-prior lambda partly
fix_map.SETUP: PORYGON2 v2 (value of a boosted foe); the human-prior lambda partly (humans punish setup)
fix_map.OUTSPED: team spreads (1.35.0, built, not yet played) for games 22 and 23 only (Scarf Basculegion to Speed SP 32); games 9 and 26 are the opponent's hidden Speed SP (XATU's uniform spread prior), and 1.35.0 leaves our Sneasler and Gengar at Speed SP 0
fix_map.SUCKER_PUNCH: none of the planned fixes directly; the human-prior lambda partly
fix_map.BEHIND_FROM_PREVIEW: CHOMP v2 (spreads and field) and the top-meta rotation
fix_map.PERISH: none planned: ROTOM's world builder must lay the Perish count (and a swapped ability)
